definitions.explanation: A document certifying that someone has passed an examination, inspection, or qualification test.

examples.japanese: {合格証|ごうかくしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}かって→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧{合格証|ごうかくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I passed the exam and received a certificate.

examples.japanese: {合格証|ごうかくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}→再発行：18901_saihakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: There is a fee for reissuing the passing certificate.

notes:
A {合格証|ごうかくしょう} is an official certificate proving that someone has successfully passed an examination or met a standard. It is commonly issued for qualification exams such as {漢字検定|かんじけんてい} or {日本語能力試験|にほんごのうりょくしけん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合格証書|ごうかくしょうしょ} — formal certificate of passing (longer, more official form)
- {合格証明書|ごうかくしょうめいしょ} — certificate proving one has passed
- {合格証|ごうかくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提示|ていじ}する→提示する：26842_teijisuru⟧ — to present a passing certificate
- {合格証|ごうかくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紛失|ふんしつ}する→紛失する：18835_funshitsusuru⟧ — to lose a passing certificate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {修了証|しゅうりょうしょう} — certificate of completion (for finishing a course, not necessarily passing an exam)
- ⟦{免許証|めんきょしょう}→免許証：03160_menkyoshou⟧ — license (authorizes the holder to do something, such as drive)
- ⟦{資格証|しかくしょう}→資格証：26034_shikakushou⟧ — qualification certificate
